description: This file defines a Java interface 'CleanupCommand' which extends a generic 'Command' interface. It includes default implementations for command type prefix, resource type, resource path, and category, and declares an abstract method to get the entity ID to clean up snapshots and journal entries. Additionally, it contains a nested class 'JsonFields' defining JSON schema fields related to the command, particularly the 'entityId'. The interface is aimed at representing cleanup commands within a database context, particularly related to journal and snapshot management in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CleanupCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for JSON fields used in 'CleanupCommand', specifically the 'entityId' field.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the cleanup command, specifying which snapshots and journal entries to clean up.
